messages:
elaine: Quick sync: final announce is Friday 09:00 PT. Need freeze on changelog + docs anchors by 17:00 PT today. Also confirm: (a) canary windows, (b) webinar CTA copy, (c) where perf slides will live.

sam: I'll freeze changelog. Link will be https://redwood.example.com/changelog/releases/2026-03-21-orbit when done.

pranav: Canary plan: internal at 06:30 PT Fri, 10% external at 09:00 PT, 50% by 12:00 PT, global by 20:00 PT. 30m rollback after each deployment.

elaine: Can we avoid the 09:00 precise jump during live webinar? Webinar starts 09:30 PT.

pranav: We'll shift the major traffic jumps to 11:00 PT to keep demo stable. Minor 10% go-live stays at 09:00 PT.

maria: Webinar CTA: "Register for the Orbit launch demo — limited spots". Approved?

jen: Perf team uploaded charts to https://drive.redwood.com/launch/perf/orbit-viz. PNGs + CSVs in the /snapshots folder.

deploy-bot: Posting deploy progress to #release-war-room. Will flag any P1/P2 regressions.

elaine: Thanks. Sam, post the changelog permalink and docs anchor (#orbit-details) by 17:00 PT. We'll schedule social & email.

sam: Done plan. Will update here when live.

maria: Drafting email now — short announce + link to changelog, plus follow-up with perf highlights.

elaine: Final preflight 1hr before internal canary in #release-war-room. :rocket:
